models.name: salience_base_rate_ambiguity_l1 (exported)
models.rationale: RSA pragmatic listener at depth 1 with inductive base-rate prior, feature complexity, and speaker ambiguity cost. Refinement of salience_base_rate_ambiguity_l2: reduces recursion depth from depth 2 to depth 1. Listeners interpret referential expressions by inverting a speaker who reasons about a literal listener with cognitive ambiguity costs, while evaluating candidate referents through an inductive prior combining empirical familiarization base rates and visual feature complexity.

models.name: salience_distractor_base_rate
models.rationale: Distractor attenuation listener with joint base-rate and feature-complexity prior. Refinement of distractor_attenuation_base_rate: listeners operate under visual attentional constraints that attenuate non-matching distractors during speaker simulation, while evaluating candidate referents through an inductive prior that combines empirical familiarization base rates with cognitive parsimony (favoring objects with fewer visual features).

models.name: diminishing_ambiguity_cost_l2
models.rationale: RSA pragmatic listener at depth 2 with inductive base-rate prior, feature complexity, and diminishing ambiguity cost. Refinement of salience_base_rate_ambiguity_l2: replaces the linear speaker ambiguity cost with an information-theoretic logarithmic ambiguity cost proportional to the referential entropy of candidate extensions. Speakers incur diminishing marginal penalties as the competitor set size grows, rather than a constant marginal penalty per additional distractor.

models.name: salience_base_rate_ambiguity_l2
models.rationale: RSA pragmatic listener at depth 2 with inductive base-rate prior, feature complexity, and speaker ambiguity cost. Refinement of base_rate_ambiguity_l2: extends the model with a feature-complexity prior over referents (from feature_salience_l2). Listeners evaluate candidate referents through an inductive prior combining empirical familiarization base rates with cognitive parsimony (favoring objects with fewer features) while reasoning at depth 2 with speaker ambiguity costs.

models.name: rsa_l2 (seed)
models.rationale: RSA pragmatic listener at depth 2, uniform prior over objects. One more level of recursion than the vanilla model: a speaker S2 chooses words by how well the depth-1 pragmatic listener L1 would recover the object (exp(alpha * log L1)), and the listener L2 inverts S2. Depth-2 reasoning is what the pragmods "complex" game needs to single out the object described by the twice-implicated word. One rationality alpha at every level; uniform choice with no informative word; a lapse parameter mixes in uniform guessing.

metric.lede: How well each model predicts which referent people pick in the held-out conditions: conditions of the same papers that the loop never saw. Every model was fitted to the loop's training trials only. The panels show people's choice proportions against the models' predictions for each held-out game, word and condition.
metric.standing_note: Held-out log predictive density behind the best of these models, in nats (whiskers ±2 SE of the difference, clustered by held-out condition). Lower is better. r and RMSE compare predicted and observed choice proportions over held-out display cells.
